title: Day 768: Unknown Gunmen Leave Funeral Wreath and Threatening Graffiti Outside Culiacán Private School
detail: During the night of Sunday, August 30, 2026, unidentified individuals arrived by vehicle at the Colegio Inglés de Durango, on Boulevard Villas del Río in Culiacán, left a funeral wreath at the entrance, and spray-painted intimidating graffiti in black paint on one of the school's perimeter fences. A 911 report brought elements of the Grupo Interinstitucional to the scene, who removed the wreath and established a surveillance point; no one was harmed and authorities had not identified who was responsible or their motive as of the following day. The incident came on the eve of the start of the 2026–2027 school year across Sinaloa, amid the ongoing Chapitos–Mayos faction war that has gripped the state since September 2024; Sepyc (the state education secretariat) confirmed classes would proceed as scheduled at the school under reinforced security.

media.caption: Army and state police secure schools across Sinaloa after a threatening funeral wreath was left outside a Culiacán private school, August 30-31, 2026

title: Day 768: Escuinapa Transit Subdirector Miguel Antonio Zazueta Páez Found Shot Dead at His Home
detail: Miguel Antonio Zazueta Páez, subdirector of Public Safety and Municipal Transit for Escuinapa, was found dead with gunshot wounds outside his residence in the Infonavit Las Fuentes sector during the early hours of Sunday, August 30, 2026, after an anonymous call alerted authorities. A cardboard sign bearing a message attributed to a criminal group was found near the body; its contents were not disclosed. Zazueta Páez had held the post for only 27 days, having been appointed August 3, 2026 as part of a renewal of the municipality's public-safety and transit command. His death — confirmed by officials August 31 — marked the second high-ranking Escuinapa security official killed in five months, following the March 31, 2026 highway ambush that killed operational subdirector Esteban Gutiérrez Mazariegos. The state Secretaría de Seguridad Pública deployed the Grupo Interinstitucional, combining municipal, state and federal forces, to reinforce Escuinapa in response.

media.caption: Miguel Antonio Zazueta Páez, Escuinapa's transit subdirector, was found shot dead outside his home in the Infonavit Las Fuentes sector, August 30, 2026
